positive_required: Real nonempty PREFLIGHT_ONLY build -> actual fixture online backup/final plan -> independently labeled synthetic review/scope -> real nonempty STOP_ONCE build -> one real commit/native wait/lease/postflight -> immutable inspect

cuts.case: default empty, bad base64, duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, empty/zero SHA
cuts.expect: deny before DB/backup/process; no success credit for default denial alone

cuts.case: replace caller plan/expect SHA/review/scope/evidence together with a self-consistent forged set
PREFLIGHT_ONLY commit or STOP_ONCE new preflight/backup
cuts.expect: action not granted; no cross-phase escalation

cuts.case: member evidence corruption or semantic subject/acceptance conflict despite top-level file integrity
expiry before start, after lock wait, before intent; backward wallclock in current invocation
cuts.expect: zero action; bounded monotonic lifetime cannot grow

cuts.case: expiry after one termination, repeated commit, two concurrent same-op invocations
cuts.expect: at most one native call; final wait/recovery never retries

cuts.case: crash before/after intent, torn journal, intent without native outcome
cuts.expect: UNKNOWN/no second call; inspect does not commit

cuts.case: PID reuse/image or parent/root/Host/Owner/native identity drift
cuts.expect: zero action; original retained handle remains sole target

cuts.case: S209/S216 real schema24 reservation and post-stop drift through grant-aware command path
cuts.expect: dangerous prestate refused; observed stop plus drift is MAINTENANCE_BLOCKED and journaled

cuts.case: nonempty positive E2E and expired inspect of completed journal
cuts.expect: one exact real fixture stop; original wait/lease/baseline verified; expired inspect reads only existing receipts

cuts.case: binary built with fixture grant pointed at any other process/root or proof class
cuts.expect: reject; synthetic fixture authority cannot match actual product
